ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65:35 ratio of high-intensity (white/light grey) to low-intensity (dark/black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity base with extensive low-intensity mottling. Dense dark clusters concentrated along the leading edges and central longitudinal axis of both lobes; several distinct vertical dark linear bands on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped vertex approximately 120 degrees; base of the notch is partially occluded by high-intensity water spray pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge; peak-to-valley pixel amplitude varies significantly, ranging from 3 to 15 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature originating from the median notch and sweeping toward the distal tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, low-intensity circular clusters scattered across the high-intensity medial regions of both lobes, suggesting focal scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct near-vertical, low-intensity linear streaks present on the inner-half of the right lobe (image-right).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavily textured, irregular protrusions at both distal tips, characterized by high-contrast pixel clusters indicative of significant barnacle colonization or prior physical trauma.
